items.implication: Full return from knee issue for Week 1
items.opportunity: High target share expected if healthy

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play per weekend reports summary.
items.why: Weekend injury reports summary from ETR
items.implication: Opens Saints backfield to Etienne-led committee

items.text: Kenneth Walker ran for 173 yards in Chiefs debut — most for any KC player since Mahomes became starter.
items.implication: Immediate feature back in KC; high ROS value

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2.
items.implication: Core four locked in as elite shares; fade depth
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly on touches/targets for listed players

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7 targets all caught); only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Great matchup vs CLE next.
items.implication: Sustainable role with GL work; healthy post-injury
items.opportunity: Goal-line and route edge over Gainwell

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; status up in air for next week vs Raiders.
items.implication: Potential miss or limited Week 2; monitor practice
items.opportunity: Role expansion for other LAC WRs if out

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after meniscus trim.
items.implication: Potential return soon; monitor for Week 2
items.opportunity: If out, Mayer or others benefit

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 (Etienne/Miller/Donaldson), routes 24/5/7, opportunities 18/9/4.
items.why: Surprise lack of dominance in snaps/routes/opps
items.implication: Not full workhorse even solo; committee persists

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game; MRI upcoming. Coach confirms DTD.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or close; not long-term
items.opportunity: If misses, Lane/others elevated but Lane also injured

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), plus others including Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist).
items.implication: Multiple key WRs DTD entering Week 2
items.opportunity: Potential role shifts if any miss

items.text: Jeremiyah Love active is risk/reward RB2; starting everywhere owned. Wouldn't activate if worried about injury, but Cardinals risk remains.
Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason belief in Bears offense unchanged despite Week 1. Concern noted but still want shares.
items.why: Buy-low after quiet Week 1; 92% routes context from prior notes
items.opportunity: High route share if targets rebound
